sanskrit: इन्द्रियाणि मनो बुद्धिरस्याधिष्ठानमुच्यते । एतैर्विमोहयत्येष ज्ञानमावृत्य देहिनम् ॥
hindiTranslation: इन्द्रियाँ, मन और बुद्धि इस कामके वासस्थान कहे गये हैं ।  यह काम इन इन्द्रियाँ, मन और बुद्धि के द्वारा ज्ञानको ढककर देहाभिमानी मनुष्यको मोहित करता है ॥
englishTranslation: The senses, the mind, and the discerning mind are said to be its seat. Through them, it deludes the embodied person by veiling understanding.
essence: Desire conquers by hijacking the mind's own instruments.
speaker: Krishna
simpleMeaning: Desire works through the senses, the restless mind, and the discerning mind. It clouds understanding and makes a person act blindly.
simpleInsight: You are less helpless when you can see how desire takes over your mind.
detailedMeaning: Krishna is tracing the enemy inside the human system. Desire works from within, using the senses, the restless mind, and even the discerning mind to cloud judgment.
modernRelevance: A student sits down to study, glances at the cricket score, then the highlights, then a match replay. Desire came in through the eyes, then took the mind, and by evening the judgment to stop was gone.
translationLiteral: इन्द्रियाणि (the senses) / मनः (the mind) / बुद्धिः (the discerning mind) / अस्य (of this) / अधिष्ठानम् (seat, basis) / उच्यते (is said to be) । / एतैः (through these) / विमोहयति (deludes) / एषः (this) / ज्ञानम् (understanding) / आवृत्य (covering) / देहिनम् (the embodied one)
insight: Senses, mind and intellect are desire's seat, Krishna says, and from there it veils understanding.
